study type: Retrospective cohort study / Medication-wide association study (MWAS)
exposure: comorbidities diagnosed within 2 years prior to birth
Comorbidities diagnosed within 2 years prior to birth
cohort: 2,830 pregnancies with medication exposure (out of 63,334 deliveries) at PennMedicine
finding: Out of 31 repurposed COVID-19 medications prescribed during pregnancy, 21 (68%) were not positively associated with an increased risk of cesarean section, preterm birth, or stillbirth.
